referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes a converter used in the power electronics of the drivetrain for an electric passenger car. The data from this dataset is based on direct information from the Swiss manufacturer Brusa.The entries are given as a function of kg device. The specific converter which was used for this dataset weights 4.5 kg and is suitable for a 100kW electric drivetrain.; UUID: 918b10c6-3c7c-34dd-a31e-0040e99c5a2d
referenceFunction.name: Converter, for electric passenger car
